{{Quote|Is everyone on this planet homicidal?|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="marvel83" />}}
'''Drogheda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] that was rich in [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and had a strong [[Mining/Legends|mining]] industry as of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Drogheda was ruled by a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] until [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when a popular [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|revolutionary front]] overthrew the reigning [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] with the intention of installing a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government. Sarna was transported into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who played a role in the revolution.

==Description==
A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> Drogheda was a world of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and dramatic cliffs, a rugged landscape that ensured that many of its inhabited areas could not be reached over land. The planet was rich in natural resources, and the planet's [[Ore/Legends|ore]] fueled a profitable [[Mining/Legends|mining]] sector on Drogheda.<ref name="marvel83" /> During the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Drogheda received [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] shipments from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="idiots">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|When your sister said that she had a job for me, Danu, I didn't realize it was ''target practice''&mdash;or is this what passes for the welcome wagon on Drogheda?|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="marvel83" />}}
During the [[Kymoodon Era]], Drogheda was one of several worlds assaulted by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-backed forces in areas that were then beyond the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] frontier&mdash;fragmentary information on the battle was later uncovered in a [[Kymoodon-era government archive]] on [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="wfcut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref> Drogheda was governed by a traditional [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] until [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when a popular [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|revolutionary movement]] arose during the unrest following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], aiming to overthrow [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] and install a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government. Although much of the rebellion was massacred by regime forces at [[Mount Meru Mine]], the revolutionaries ultimately stormed the [[Drogheda Citadel]] through the planning of Sarna's sister [[Danu]] and a timely distraction from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Sarna was deposed and sent into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], and Calrissian was also forced to leave despite his part in aiding the revolution.<ref name="marvel83" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Since my father's death I've ruled Drogheda the best I can. I've always put the welfare of my ''people'' above everything else.|Queen Sarna|<ref name="marvel83" />}}
Although governed by an aristocratic, traditional monarchy, mining was the most important sector of the Droghedan economy, and rebellion against the upper class fomented within the blue-collar miners. The miners repurposed the shafts and tunnels in which they worked to serve as staging grounds for their revolution.<ref name="marvel83" />

==Locations==
Drogheda's [[Politics/Legends|political]] center was the massive Drogheda Citadel, a virtually impregnable fortress located at the top of a soaring peak, which was only accessible via [[sky-sled]]. The building's gleaming interior was richly appointed, and until 4 ABY the planet's monarch governed from a circular throne room in the citadel's heart. By contrast, much of the blue-collar miners who formed the revolution in 4 ABY inhabited the planet's mines, which served as shelters deep within the mountains.<ref name="marvel83" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drogheda appeared as the setting of [[Star Wars (1977) 83|''Star Wars'' (1977) 83]], written by [[Linda Grant]], illustrated by [[Bob McLeod]] and released in [[1984]].<ref name="marvel83" />
